name: psionics
description: Psionics — the Exodus discipline, Phase 1 (psychometry + telekinesis). The substrate is server/engine/psionics.js and the vocabulary is server/engine/psionics-abilities.js; this plugin is the verbs. Two rules carry it. The body pays: strain is a ladder of nosebleeds, blood from the ears, a seizure, and finally real injury through the ordinary damage path, which is the only thing bounding how long a psion can push. And psychometry reads the world's own exhaust rather than inventing fiction — residue.js listens to events that already fire and no other system was modified to feed it. Telekinesis is a DELIVERY MECHANISM for verbs that already exist (`reach` fires the specialized-action registry), never a parallel set of them.

ticks.what: stillness posture (drains resonance, surfaces one residue line) and ward upkeep (drains while a field stands, collapses at empty and SAYS so — a shield that vanishes silently is a shield you get killed behind). One Map walk over live players; both halves early-out on a player doing neither.

lockTypes: psi — Exodus doors. authFn is `isAwakened`, nothing more: opening a door the Exodus already tuned is the lowest thing the discipline does, and gating it harder would lock initiates out of their own home. Not hackable, not pickable; mark Exodus doors unbreakable in content the way the Long Watch blast door is. First refusal fires the guide's one-shot explanation (`psi_walked_into_door`) and every refusal after it is a flat, unexplained non-opening.

terminusgate — the outer gate at Terminus, and a DIFFERENT question from `psi`: that one asks what you can do, this one asks what you are. Two halves, both required. (1) `terminus_admitted`, set by the child at the gate once both errands are done — the gate is never opened by standing at it. (2) The mind must not already be somebody else's: it reads the ordinary `path_*` ideology flags and refuses when machine/flesh/human is at or above `path_mind`, so a tie refuses too. It deliberately does NOT read reputation — standing is what you have done, the path is what you decided to be, and only the second one is a door with another order's name on it. The path refusal fires Verity Strand's one-shot line (`terminus_gate_told`) because a player who did everything and is refused invisibly is looking at a bug; every other refusal is flat. It must NOT be `psi`: the purifier chair that awakens you is INSIDE the wall, so gating the gate on awakening would put the door in front of its own key.
extensionPoints: registerPsiResistor(fn, owner) — contribute to how hard a mind is to reach. Resistance is DERIVED from who you already are (Cool, Brains, Long Watch mastery, Static Mind, a coprocessor), never authored as a second trainable skill. See server/engine/psi-resist.js.

registerDiscipline / registerPsiAbility — the vocabulary. An ability naming an unregistered discipline or target kind is a BUILD FAILURE (unknownAbilityKeys), and a discipline with no abilities in it is too (unreachableDisciplines).

player_flags `psi_rank` (the eight-rung ladder) and `psi_focus` / `psi_focus_second` (major and minor). Rank is depth, focus is breadth: you major in one art and minor in another, and you are only ever truly exceptional in your major.
